summary: The candidate implements real row-wise logits chunking for the ordinary CUDA DeepGEMM paged and nonpaged paths, and its focused regressions pass. Independent arithmetic shows that the reported 4096 x align256(92992) fp32 allocation is reduced from 1.421875 GiB to 674-row chunks (251224064 bytes) when 1.17 GiB is free. The row-wise Top-K invariant also held on the assigned gfx950 GPU. It is nevertheless a partial fix: PagedIndexerMetadata._mqa_logits_budget explicitly returns None for prefill CUDA-graph execution and graph capture, leaving the original full context-proportional allocation in those paths. The helper also knowingly exceeds the budget when one aligned logits row is larger than the budget. The exact reported H100/TP4/full-model workload could not be run here.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression import: the recorded base lacks mqa_logits_budget_bytes and the DSV4 budget/chunking implementation. Raw JUnit: /job/review-evidence-j-ffee774bdf58/base-regression.xml.
Candidate focused regression suite: 21 passed, 25 subtests passed. Raw JUnit: /job/review-evidence-j-ffee774bdf58/candidate-focused.xml.

tests.command: Independent Python arithmetic/budget probe at exact candidate
tests.what_was_measured: The issue shape is 1526726656 bytes. With 1.17 GiB free and the default 0.2 fraction, the candidate selects 674 rows and a 251224064-byte chunk. It also showed prefill_graph_budget=None and that budgets below the 372736-byte aligned row size are exceeded by the minimum one-row launch.

tests.command: Independent GPU Top-K equivalence probe at exact candidate
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, sorted page selections for 37 rows were identical between the unchunked transform and row chunks of 1, 7, 16, and 36. This validates only the row-wise reduction invariant, not CUDA DeepGEMM or the full model.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) executed the independent torch Top-K equivalence fixture. The changed CUDA DeepGEMM allocation path and the reported 4xH100 TP4 workload were not executable on this architecture.

remaining_counterexamples: When use_prefill_cuda_graph is true, PagedIndexerMetadata._mqa_logits_budget returns None before checking the issue-sized matrix. rows_per_chunk therefore remains None (absent the unrelated SM120 row cap), and the full context-proportional logits allocation remains.
During CUDA graph capture, breakable CUDA graph execution, or TC piecewise CUDA graph execution, the same method returns None and disables memory-budget chunking.

If the available budget is smaller than one aligned logits row, mqa_logits_rows_per_chunk returns one row even though that allocation exceeds the budget; sufficiently wide contexts or extremely low free memory can still OOM.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights were unavailable, so no 800K-token HTTP request or semantic model validation was performed.
The assigned hardware was one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, not 4xH100; CUDA DeepGEMM, TP4 replication, and multi-rank behavior remain unverified.
No native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable. Python imports resolved from /job/repo/python; Torch was 2.11.0+rocm7.2 with HIP 7.2.26015.
The deterministic tiny Llama serving fixture is not architecture-qualified for DeepSeek-V4 and would not exercise this indexer, so it was not used as substitute proof.
